name: Giant Rat

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The rat has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 feet. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

description: Giant rats swarm through sewers, middens, and dungeon refuse piles, breeding quickly wherever filth and easy prey are abundant.
